research_rationale: The complete EO12813 text creates a new AID advisory commission; the prior statutory commission termination on May 16, 1992 is historical context, not this order’s ending. All functions, funding, compensation, administrative and FACA directions depend on the new Commission. Original §4(b) requires termination not later than September 30, 1992. EO12815 replaces that date with December 31, 1992; the immediate amendment directive has no delayed effective clause, so its September 30, 1992 execution is the amendment date by textual inference. The original date provision ends on amendment; remaining dependent commands cease under the amended express terminal date December 31, 1992. No supplied provision makes report completion itself an earlier terminating trigger. EO12869 §§4(b),6 formally revoke effective September 30, 1993, after the own-term ending. Adjacent Treasury regulation effective dates in the EO12815 context concern a different instrument. No independent executive command or savings clause survives; accrued travel reimbursement arises under the cited statute, not an ongoing commission mandate. The post-1937 OFR catalog/corpus search supplies bounded later-event coverage with both relevant actors held and no listed conflict or missing provision. No current-law/readiness assertion is made. Frozen full-run re-confirmation: Full-run audit preserves EO12815 extension and EO12869 revocation as the only named actor events. EO12815 provision ends before signature but retains the full immediate date-replacement directive; the complete actor context supplies its September 30, 1992 execution and no deferred commencement. Original §4(b) date amendment on September 30, 1992 and amended December 31, 1992 terminal date remain supported. The prior statutory commission ending May 16, 1992 is not this Commission’s end; report recommendations are not a termination trigger. The original and full actor-context text bytes and hashes are identical to those substantively read before freeze. The original metadata grade now reads original_representation_unverified, with requires_page_check false; no page-image inspection is asserted. Added alternative actor records are duplicate exact-text or normalized transcriptions of these same provisions, without a competing legal direction. EO12869 §6 expressly establishes September 30, 1993 effectiveness; this later formal revocation is not the first ending. Corrected inventory spans were reconstructed against the new original evidence and remain exact, exhaustive and disjoint. Accrued statutory travel reimbursement may survive, but no independent continuing executive function or transfer is found. No conflicts, missing provisions or current-law leads are present; the same post-1937 bounded OFR search remains accepted, without treating USC release coverage through October 9 as current law through October 14. This reconfirms producer approval for review against the frozen dossier and makes no readiness/status/independent-review assertion.
